title: Descending into the forest on a rainy morning
author: intelligence-dev

comments.author: papapumpnz
comments.body: That actually looks pretty cool, well done.

comments.author: lostforever2011
comments.body: Yes it does looks pretty nice. Mind sharing how you did it pls?

comments.author: Cool-Chemical-5629
comments.body: It's cool, but worlds themselves are usually the easy part. The next step - populating them with everything from towns to cities and NPCs is still something even the best of the current AI models struggle with.

replies.author: LocoMod
replies.body: Rendering a world with this level of detail at 33ms per frame is incredibly hard. I’ve yet to see anyone else do it. Most of these voxel demos at this voxel pitch are either bare landscapes, or a small diorama. OP looks to have overcome the initial performance wall.

comments.author: ArcaneMoose
comments.body: Great performance for that level of detail! Any tips for rendering stuff like this efficiently? I wonder if smoothing away the hard edges would have a big perf hit or not?
